The people said it wasn't time to build God's house while they lived in panelled houses. Where might your priorities be out of order?
"Consider your ways. You have sown much, and harvested little." What does it mean to consider your ways?
The Lord stirred up the spirit of the people and they worked. What is God stirring you to do?
"I am with you, declares the Lord." What does this promise mean for your work?
"Be strong... work, for I am with you... My Spirit remains in your midst. Fear not." Where do you need this encouragement?
"The latter glory of this house shall be greater than the former." How does Jesus fulfil this?
"From this day on I will bless you." What new blessing are you trusting God for?
